metadata.title: Kien Nguyen Dinh | Front-end Engineer
metadata.description: Kien Nguyen Dinh — front-end engineer in Da Nang. React and Next.js, 4+ years on product UI.
metadata.keywords: Front-end Engineer, ReactJS, NextJS, Kien Nguyen Dinh, Portfolio, Da Nang

hero.lead: I write <highlight>frontend</highlight> for products people actually live in — admin tools, portals, storefronts. Mostly <highlight>React</highlight> and Next.js. I care about how a screen feels: is it clear, is it quick, does it still hold up on a phone after a few sprints.

expertise.title: Frontend Expertise
expertise.subtitle: What I spend most of my time on: the UI, the data going into it, and keeping both reasonably fast.
expertise.impactTitle: How I like an interface to feel
expertise.impactDesc: It has to work. After that I want it to feel good — motion that isn't noisy, layouts that survive a small screen, pages that don't take forever.

uiux.title: UI / UX
uiux.desc: Hierarchy, spacing, and whether someone can find the thing they came for.

react.title: React & Next.js

state.title: State Management
state.desc: Redux Saga, RxJS, or React Query — whichever fits the product, not a stack for its own sake.

api.title: API Integration
api.desc: REST and GraphQL. A lot of the work is loading states, errors, and stale data.

responsive.title: Responsive Design
responsive.desc: If it only looks right on a 1440px monitor, it isn't done.

performance.title: Performance
performance.desc: Bundle size, extra re-renders, and how the page feels on a mid-range phone.

personal.name: Kien Nguyen Dinh
personal.title: Front-end Engineer
personal.summary: Front-end engineer, 4+ years. React and Next.js. Most of my work is product UI — dashboards, vendor portals, storefronts — plus the APIs and state that feed them.

projects.name: Intern Management System
highlights: A small web app for universities and companies to keep intern records in one place
I was in on the research, the UI, and the actual build

projects.name: Phone Store Application
highlights: An online phone shop: browse, product pages, cart
I built the storefront pieces — list, detail, cart
State sat in Redux Saga

projects.name: Car Rental Web Application

PayPal for the payment step
Set up the frontend structure and how state moved around

projects.name: PGO Web Event / Admin / Landing Page

Made the layouts work on smaller screens and cut some of the UI weight
Wired GraphQL and kept the frontend data flow in check

projects.name: Game Configuration Admin (Boom / Fish)

UI components and the logic around them

projects.name: PapaHub – Game Configuration Platform

Screens to set up and customize a game
API work and a few performance passes on the UI

projects.name: SST – Ticket Sales Integration Platform (Product)

Buy flow and ticket management screens
Shared components, then hooked them to the backend

Interactions, plus keeping the thing working after launch
Bugfixes and small UX cleanups

projects.name: Procuva – E-commerce Web Application

React components for product management, vendor listings, and the customer-facing bits

Digital signatures for document approval in the workflow
Admin side: workflows, RBAC, system config
API integration and how data moved between screens
Sat with backend and QA when things broke

projects.name: DTTG – Government Digitalization System

Reusable React components
APIs plus React state for the data flow
